content: उद्भू €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To arise, spring up, be produced from; उदभून्मुरजध्वनिः, अन्तरीक्षात्सरस्वती <ab>&c.</ab> see उद्भव below. .²2 To occur, take place; उदभवत्तीव्रो दुर्भिक्षः <ls>Ks. 27. 94</ls>. .²3 To ascend, go up, mount. .²4 To suffice. .²5 To rise in arms, revolt, rebel. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To cause to exist, create, produce; मायां मयोद्भाव्य परीक्षितोसि <ls>R. 2. 62</ls>. .²2 To proclaim; माहात्म्यम् <ls>K. 109</ls>. .²3 To use, employ. .²4 To raise, elevate. .²5 To consider, think; <ls>Vikr. 9. 19</ls>.
